name: Chat Bot Alpha Interface
author: alphainterface

sections.description:
Chat Bot Alpha Interface makes it simple to embed the <hash-bot> widget directly into your WordPress site — no coding required.

The plugin loads via a CDN, so you don’t have to worry about manual script embedding or performance issues. In just a few clicks, you’ll have an AI voice chatbot live on every page of your site, ready to engage visitors, answer questions, and capture leads.

Key Features:
– 🎙️ Voice-enabled chatbot — interactive conversations, not just text.
– ⚡ Lightweight & fast — loads via CDN, minimal overhead.
– 🎨 Customizable design — adjust chatbot width, height, icon size, and more.
– 🔌 Backend integration — connect via Alpha Interface’s Agent UUID and Chat ID.
– 🛠️ Easy setup — configure directly inside WordPress admin.

Admin Settings (WP Admin → Settings → Chat Bot Settings):
– Bot Name
– Agent UUID
– Chat ID
– Icon Size
– Chatbot Width
– Chatbot Height

Source Code

The uncompressed, human-readable source code for this plugin is available here:
https://github.com/clockhash-projects/hash-bot-fe
sections.installation:
1. Download the alpha-interface-dynamic-bot.zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  3. Upload the file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Configure your chatbot under Settings → Chat Bot Settings.
  6. That’s it! The chatbot widget will now appear on every page.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The chatbot widget is designed to be theme-agnostic and works on any WordPress theme.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes. You can adjust icon size, widget width, height, and bot name from the settings page.

Is the chatbot text-only or voice-enabled?

It supports both — you can enable AI voice interactions.
